name: TITAN® AV-841R FULL BRIM
intro: The AVES® TITAN® AV-841R Full Brim Helmet delivers uncompromising head protection through its rugged HDPE shell and extended brim design. Engineered for high-impact industrial settings, it features a 6-point ratchet suspension system with vertical adjustment points, offering customizable fit, adaptability and reliable 360° protection against falling objects, sun exposure, rain, and splashes.

features.head: HDPE Protective Shell
features.text: High-density polyethylene construction provides strong impact resistance with minimal weight

features.head: 360° Full Brim Coverage
features.text: Extended protection against sun exposure, rain, and falling objects

features.head: Ratchet Suspension System
features.text: 6-point harness with push and pull knob enables quick and precise fit adjustment

features.head: Adjustable Vertical Settings
features.text: Front and rear height positions ensure balanced, secure positioning

features.head: Low-Profile Non-Vented Design
features.text: Improves stability and performance in tight work environments

features.head: Replaceable Components
features.text: Interchangeable brow pad and suspension extend service life

spec: Ratchet - Pull out to adjust, press to lock
standards: ANSI/ISEA Z89.1-2014 Type I, Class E & G
assembly: Ratchet suspension: pull out to adjust, press to lock
